name: Banana peanut butter protein oats
description: Warm creamy rolled oats topped with sliced banana and rich peanut butter.
steps: Simmer rolled oats with milk in a saucepan over medium heat for five minutes.
Transfer to a bowl and top with freshly sliced banana, peanut butter and chia seeds.

name: Chocolate banana oats
description: Warm oats cooked with unsweetened cocoa powder and finished with sweet ripe banana.
steps: Stir oats, cocoa powder and milk in a saucepan over gentle heat until thick.
Pour into a bowl, sweeten with honey and garnish with banana slices.

name: Apple cinnamon oats
description: Warm spiced oats simmered with grated apple, ground cinnamon and toasted almonds.
steps: Grate half the apple and dice the rest.
Cook oats, grated apple, milk and cinnamon in a pan for six minutes.
Top with diced apple and chopped toasted almonds.

name: Overnight oats with milk and nuts
description: Rolled oats soaked overnight with chilled milk, yogurt, crushed walnuts and honey.
steps: Combine oats, milk, curd and honey in a glass jar.
Refrigerate overnight or for at least four hours.
Scatter chopped walnuts over the top before eating.

name: Mango oats smoothie
description: A thick, vibrant smoothie made from sweet ripe mango, rolled oats and chilled milk.
steps: Add mango, rolled oats, chilled milk and curd to a blender.
Blend on high speed until completely velvety.
Pour into a tall glass and enjoy immediately.

name: Strawberry banana smoothie
description: A refreshing pink breakfast smoothie with ripe banana, strawberries and thick curd.
steps: Rinse strawberries and hull them.
Combine strawberries, banana, curd, milk and honey in a blender.
Blend until smooth and frothy.

name: Chocolate peanut butter smoothie
description: Rich chocolate smoothie blended with banana, creamy peanut butter and chilled milk.
steps: Place sliced banana, peanut butter, cocoa powder and milk in a blender jar.
Blend until creamy and thick.
Pour into a glass and sprinkle with chia seeds.

name: Banana walnut smoothie
description: Nutty and wholesome morning smoothie made with ripe bananas, soaked walnuts and cold milk.
steps: Roughly chop walnuts.
Blend banana, walnuts, milk, cinnamon and honey until thoroughly combined.
Serve chilled in a wide glass.

name: Dates and peanut butter smoothie
description: Naturally sweet shake with soft seeded dates, peanut butter and creamy milk.
steps: Pit the dates and soak in warm milk for five minutes.
Transfer to a blender along with peanut butter and oats.
Blend until smooth and luxurious.

name: Yogurt, granola and fruit bowl
description: Creamy strained yogurt topped with golden granola, fresh fruit and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Spoon thick curd into a wide breakfast bowl.
Arrange diced apple and banana neatly over one half.
Add crunchy granola to the other side and finish with honey.

name: Peanut butter banana toast
description: Warm toasted whole wheat bread generously spread with peanut butter and layered with banana.
steps: Toast bread slices until crisp and golden brown.
Spread one tablespoon of peanut butter across each slice.
Arrange sliced banana on top and dust with cinnamon.

name: Honey banana toast
description: Golden toasted bread with lightly mashed banana, wild honey and roasted sunflower seeds.
steps: Toast bread in a pan with a smear of butter until crisp.
Mash the banana roughly with a fork and spread across toast.
Drizzle with honey and top with crunchy seeds.

name: Grilled paneer cheese sandwich
description: Golden crusty sandwich packed with spiced crumbled paneer and melted cheese.
steps: Crumble paneer and season with black pepper, roasted cumin and salt.
Spread green chutney on bread, layer paneer and cheese.
Toast in a pan with butter on both sides until cheese is melted and crust is golden.

name: Corn and cheese sandwich
description: Toasted sandwich with sweet corn kernels, melted cheese and cracked black pepper.
steps: Mix steamed sweet corn with grated cheese and cracked black pepper.
Place mixture between bread slices.
Toast in a pan with butter over medium heat until crusty and melted.

name: Potato cheese sandwich
description: Spiced mashed potato layer topped with cheese and toasted until deep golden.
steps: Boil and mash potato with chaat masala, salt and chopped coriander.
Spread potato layer over bread, top with cheese slice and cover with second slice.
Pan toast with butter until crisp and heated through.

name: Pizza style cheese toast
description: Open face bread toasts with tomato herb sauce, diced bell pepper and bubbling melted cheese.
steps: Spread tomato herb sauce over bread slices.
Scatter diced bell pepper and generous grated cheese.
Cover pan with a lid and toast over low heat until cheese bubbles.

name: Paneer tikka sandwich
description: Marinated paneer cubes pan seared in tikka spices, layered with crunchy onions in toasted bread.
steps: Coat small paneer cubes with curd, tikka masala and salt.
Quickly sear in a pan for three minutes until browned at edges.
Layer into bread with sliced onions and toast until crunchy.

name: Mushroom cheese toast
description: Sautéed garlic mushrooms piled onto toasted sourdough with warm melted cheese.
steps: Slice mushrooms and sauté with minced garlic and butter until golden and fragrant.
Pile sautéed mushrooms onto bread slices and top with cheese.
Melt under a lid in a warm pan until bubbling.

name: Mexican bean and cheese toastie
description: Seasoned mashed kidney beans with sweet corn, salsa and melted cheese inside crunchy toast.
steps: Mash cooked rajma lightly with salsa and sweet corn.
Spread filling onto bread and top with cheese slice.
Toast in a buttered pan on both sides until crunchy.

name: Garlic cheese bread with yogurt dip
description: Garlic herb butter brushed over thick toast, melted cheese and served with chilled herb yogurt.
steps: Mix softened butter with minced garlic and oregano, then spread over bread.
Top with grated cheese and cook in a covered skillet until melted and crisp underneath.
Serve with thick curd seasoned with salt and herbs.

name: Paneer sandwich with yogurt dressing
description: Crumby spiced paneer mixed with a light seasoned yogurt dressing inside warm toast.
steps: Whisk curd with black pepper, salt and lemon juice.
Fold crumbled paneer and finely diced cucumber into the yogurt dressing.
Spoon into bread and lightly toast in a pan until warm and crusty.

name: Aloo paratha with curd
description: Flaky whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced potato filling, served with cool curd.
steps: Boil and mash potato with cumin, green chilli, salt and fresh coriander.
Roll atta dough into a circle, place potato stuffing inside, seal and gently roll flat.
Cook on a tawa with a drizzle of oil until golden on both sides and serve with curd.

name: Paneer paratha
description: Wholesome paratha stuffed with generously seasoned crumbled paneer and fresh herbs.
steps: Grate paneer and mix with garam masala, salt and finely chopped coriander.
Stuff into kneaded atta dough, roll out carefully.
Roast on a hot pan with oil until crisp and serve with creamy curd.

name: Cheese aloo paratha
description: Comforting paratha combining soft spiced mashed potatoes with gooey melted cheese.
steps: Mash boiled potato with salt, pepper and roasted cumin.
Stuff rolled dough with potato and grated cheese, then seal and roll.
Cook on a skillet with oil until puffed and golden brown.

name: Gobi paratha with yogurt
description: Finely grated cauliflower spiced with carom seeds and ginger, sealed in crisp flatbread.
steps: Grate cauliflower finely and squeeze out excess moisture.
Season with ajwain, minced ginger, chilli and salt.
Stuff into dough, roll out and shallow fry on a hot tawa. Serve with cool curd.

name: Aloo tikki wrap
description: Golden spiced potato patty wrapped in a warm whole wheat roti with mint chutney and onions.
steps: Mash boiled potato with chaat masala, shape into a patty and pan fry with oil until crisp.
Warm the roti on a tawa.
Spread mint chutney on the roti, place patty, add sliced onions and roll up tightly.

name: Paneer bhurji roll
description: Crumbled spiced paneer sautéed with onions and tomatoes, wrapped inside a soft roti.
steps: Sauté chopped onion and tomato in oil with turmeric and cumin until tender.
Crumble paneer into the pan and cook for three minutes.
Spoon into a warm roti and roll tightly.

name: Potato and cheese quesadilla
description: Crisp tortilla folded over spiced seasoned potato mash and melted cheese.
steps: Mash boiled potato with chaat masala and salt.
Spread across half of the tortilla, top with grated cheese and fold in half.
Cook in a skillet with butter until crisp and golden on both sides.

name: Rajma cheese wrap
description: Hearty kidney beans cooked with salsa, rolled with cheese in a toasted flatbread.
steps: Warm cooked rajma with salsa in a small pan for two minutes.
Spread onto a warm roti, scatter grated cheese and sliced onions.
Roll up and lightly toast on a dry pan until cheese melts.

name: Sweet corn and paneer roll
description: Juicy sweet corn and diced paneer tossed with chaat spices, rolled in a flaky paratha.
steps: Sauté sweet corn and diced paneer in a pan with chaat masala for four minutes.
Warm the roti.
Spread mint chutney on the roti, add the warm filling and roll up.

name: Homemade potato hash with cheese
description: Pan crisped grated potato hash browned in butter, topped with melted cheese and fresh herbs.
steps: Grate potatoes, rinse in cold water and squeeze dry in a clean towel.
Press into a hot skillet with melted butter and cook undisturbed for seven minutes until crisp underneath.
Flip carefully, top with cheese, cover and melt.

name: Dahi aloo chaat
description: Crispy pan tossed potato cubes tossed with whisked chilled yogurt, tamarind sauce and cumin.
steps: Pan fry boiled diced potato in a teaspoon of oil until edges are crisp and golden.
Place in a serving bowl and pour cold whisked curd over.
Drizzle tamarind and mint chutneys, then dust with chaat masala and roasted cumin.

name: Chocolate overnight oats
description: Chilled overnight oats infused with rich cocoa, milk and dark chocolate shavings.
steps: Mix oats, cocoa powder, milk, honey and chia seeds in a sealable jar.
Stir thoroughly to remove cocoa lumps.
Refrigerate overnight and stir well before eating.

name: Banana milkshake with oats
description: Thick chilled banana shake blended with wholesome oats and crushed cardamom.
steps: Add banana, rolled oats, chilled milk, cardamom and honey into a blender.
Blend on high speed for sixty seconds until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

name: Fruit and yogurt smoothie bowl
description: Thick blended fruit and yogurt bowl topped with sliced banana, pumpkin seeds and almonds.
steps: Blend thick curd with half the banana and honey until thick and spoonable.
Pour into a wide bowl.
Arrange remaining sliced banana, seasonal fruit and pumpkin seeds across the top.

name: Grilled vegetable cheese toast
description: Crisp toast layered with sliced bell peppers, tomatoes, onions and melted cheese.
steps: Arrange sliced tomato and bell pepper over bread.
Cover with grated cheese and a pinch of black pepper.
Toast in a buttered pan over medium heat until crusty and cheese melts.

name: Mini paneer pizza toast
description: Crunchy bread toast topped with pizza sauce, crumbled paneer, herbs and bubbling cheese.
steps: Spread pizza sauce evenly across bread.
Crumble paneer on top and cover with grated cheese and oregano.
Cook in a covered pan until cheese melts completely.

name: Creamy peanut butter oats
description: Thick warm oats stirred with melted peanut butter, warm milk and crushed roasted peanuts.
steps: Cook oats and milk in a pan for five minutes until thick and bubbling.
Turn off heat and stir in creamy peanut butter and honey.
Garnish with roasted crushed peanuts.

name: Banana date smoothie
description: Wholesome blended drink with ripe banana, soft Medjool dates, chilled milk and cinnamon.
steps: Soak pitted dates in warm milk for five minutes.
Transfer to a blender with banana and a pinch of cinnamon.
Blend until velvety and pour cold.

name: Potato and paneer breakfast wrap
description: Hearty breakfast roll filled with spiced potato cubes, paneer and tangy green chutney.
steps: Pan sear diced boiled potato and paneer in oil with roasted cumin and salt for five minutes.
Warm the roti.
Spread green chutney over roti, add potato and paneer, and roll.

name: Rajma chawal with cucumber salad
description: Soft red kidney beans in a fragrant spiced tomato gravy, served with fluffy basmati rice.
steps: Cook rice until tender and fluffy. Set aside.
Soften chopped onion in oil, add tomato, ginger garlic paste and spices.
Stir in cooked rajma with water, simmer gently for fifteen minutes and serve with cucumber.

name: Chole chawal with fresh salad
description: Spiced chickpeas in a rich roasted onion and tomato masala, served with rice.
steps: Cook rice until tender.
Sauté chopped onion and tomato with chole masala until fragrant.
Add cooked chickpeas and a cup of water, simmer for fifteen minutes, and serve with cucumber slices.

name: Dal tadka with steamed rice
description: Yellow toor dal tempered with cumin, garlic and dried chilli, served over hot steamed rice.
steps: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and salt until tender.
Cook rice separately until light and fluffy.
Temper hot ghee with cumin, minced garlic and tomato, pour over dal and serve together.

name: Dal fry with warm roti
description: Golden yellow dal simmered with browned onions, tomatoes and coriander, served with rotis.
steps: Cook rinsed dal with turmeric and water until tender.
Heat oil in a pan, fry onions and tomatoes with ground spices until glossy.
Add the cooked dal, simmer for five minutes and serve with warm rotis.

name: Kadhi chawal with roasted papad
description: Tangy spiced yogurt and gram flour gravy simmered with fenugreek and mustard seeds, with rice.
steps: Whisk curd with besan, turmeric, salt and water until smooth.
Temper oil with mustard seeds, fenugreek and curry leaves, then pour in kadhi mixture.
Simmer on low heat for fifteen minutes and serve over hot steamed rice.

name: Moong dal khichdi with curd
description: Comforting one pot dish of rice and split moong lentils cooked with mild cumin and turmeric.
steps: Rinse rice and moong dal together.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker, crackle cumin seeds, then add rice, dal, turmeric, salt and water.
Cook for three whistles and serve warm with cold curd.

name: Amritsari chole kulche
description: Tangy street style boiled chickpeas tossed with dried mango powder, served with toasted kulche.
steps: Toss warm cooked chickpeas with diced onion, tomato, amchur powder, green chilli and chaat masala.
Warm kulche in a skillet with a smear of butter until crisp at edges.
Serve chole with lemon wedges and hot kulche.

name: Aloo matar with warm roti
description: Homestyle potato and tender green peas simmered in a spiced tomato gravy with warm rotis.
steps: Sauté diced potato and green peas with tomato puree, turmeric and garam masala in oil.
Add half a cup of water, cover and simmer for twelve minutes until potatoes are fork tender.
Serve with freshly warmed rotis.

name: Jeera aloo with yellow dal and rice
description: Crispy cumin spiced potato cubes served alongside comforting yellow dal and steamed rice.
steps: Cook rice and moong dal in separate pots.
Dice boiled potatoes and toss in hot oil with cumin seeds, turmeric and chilli until crisp.
Serve together as a balanced homestyle platter.

name: Paneer bhurji with warm roti
description: Scrambled fresh paneer cooked with onions, tomatoes and coriander, served with warm rotis.
steps: Heat oil in a pan, sauté chopped onions and tomatoes with turmeric and red chilli powder.
Crumble paneer directly into the pan and stir fry for four minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with warm rotis.

name: Mild shahi paneer with jeera rice
description: Soft paneer cubes in a silky, mildly spiced cashew and yogurt gravy with fragrant jeera rice.
steps: Blend soaked cashews and curd with cardamom and ginger into a smooth paste.
Cook the gravy in ghee for six minutes, then add paneer cubes and simmer gently.
Cook basmati rice with cumin seeds and serve alongside.

name: Matar paneer with soft roti
description: Classic combination of soft paneer and sweet green peas in a golden onion tomato gravy.
steps: Sauté onion and tomato puree with garam masala and coriander powder.
Add green peas, water and paneer cubes, simmering for eight minutes until rich and thick.
Serve with soft rotis.

name: Dal makhani with jeera rice
description: Slow simmered whole black lentils and kidney beans with butter, tomato puree and jeera rice.
steps: Cook black lentils and tomato puree with butter and mild spices over low heat for twenty minutes.
Stir in a spoonful of curd for creaminess.
Serve over hot jeera rice.

name: Vegetable pulao with boondi raita
description: Fragrant long grain rice cooked with carrots, peas, potatoes and warm whole spices.
steps: Sauté whole spices and mixed vegetables in ghee for three minutes.
Add rinsed rice, measured water and salt, then cook covered until rice is fluffy.
Whisk curd with roasted cumin and serve with the pulao.

name: Stuffed aloo paratha with yogurt
description: Two homestyle parathas filled with spiced mashed potato, served with cool curd.
steps: Mash boiled potatoes with chopped green chilli, salt and cumin.
Stuff into atta dough discs, seal carefully and roll out.
Roast on a hot griddle with a dash of oil until golden and crisp. Serve with fresh curd.

name: Paneer kathi roll
description: Marinated paneer chunks, crunchy bell peppers and onions wrapped in a tawa toasted paratha.
steps: Sauté paneer strips, bell peppers and onions in oil with chaat masala for four minutes.
Warm the roti on a tawa.
Spread green chutney, place the filling in the centre and roll into a tight wrap.

name: Paneer tikka wrap with mint sauce
description: Charred spiced paneer cubes tossed with onions and wrapped in a soft flatbread with mint yogurt.
steps: Coat paneer and sliced bell peppers in curd and tikka masala.
Pan sear on high heat until charred at the edges.
Roll into a warm roti with mint sauce.

name: Cheese and corn wrap
description: Sweet corn tossed with herbs, creamy mayonnaise alternative, and bubbling cheese in a crisp tortilla.
steps: Warm sweet corn and bell pepper in a pan with salt and oregano.
Place onto tortilla, cover with grated cheese and roll up.
Toast in a buttered pan until golden and crisp.

name: Crispy aloo tikki burger
description: Golden pan fried spiced potato patty tucked into a toasted burger bun with mint dip and tomato.
steps: Mash boiled potato with breadcrumbs, chaat masala and cumin, then shape into a patty.
Pan fry in oil until deeply crisp on both sides.
Toast the bun, spread mint chutney, add tomato slices and the crispy patty.

name: Spiced rajma patty burger
description: Hearty burger featuring a spiced mashed kidney bean patty, sliced onions and tangy sauce.
steps: Mash cooked rajma with finely chopped onion, cumin, coriander and salt, then form a patty.
Sear in a hot oiled skillet for four minutes per side until crusty.
Assemble inside a toasted burger bun with tomato sauce and onion rings.

name: Paneer club sandwich
description: Double decker toasted sandwich packed with seasoned paneer, sliced vegetables and melted cheese.
steps: Season thinly sliced paneer with chaat masala and pan sear lightly.
Layer bottom slice with cucumber and paneer, middle slice with cheese and tomato.
Stack, toast gently in a skillet with butter until golden and slice diagonally.

name: Crispy potato wrap
description: Thin sliced potatoes pan fried with spices until crunchy, rolled in a warm roti with fresh coriander.
steps: Cut potatoes into thin batons and pan fry in oil until deeply crisp.
Toss with chaat masala, lemon juice and chopped coriander.
Roll into a warm roti with thinly sliced onions.

name: Paneer and pepper quesadilla
description: Toasted tortilla stuffed with diced paneer, sautéed bell peppers and gooey melted cheese.
steps: Quickly sauté diced paneer and bell peppers with fajita spices.
Spread on half a tortilla, cover with grated cheese, fold and press.
Cook in a hot buttered skillet until crisp on both sides and cheese is melted.

name: Cheesy bean burrito
description: Warm flour tortilla wrapped around spiced kidney beans, melted cheese and tangy tomato salsa.
steps: Warm cooked rajma with salsa and cooked rice in a small pan.
Spoon into the center of the tortilla and cover with grated cheese.
Fold sides in and roll tightly, then crisp briefly on a warm dry pan.

name: Chole and yogurt wrap
description: Spiced chickpeas combined with garlic herb yogurt and crisp lettuce in a soft wrap.
steps: Whisk curd with grated garlic, salt and mint.
Warm chickpeas with a pinch of cumin and chaat masala.
Assemble in a warm roti with sliced onions and roll.

name: Tandoori paneer sandwich
description: Crusty toasted sandwich packed with tandoori spiced paneer cubes and sliced red onion.
steps: Marinate paneer cubes with curd and tandoori masala for five minutes.
Pan sear paneer until edges blister.
Layer onto bread with sliced onions and toast with butter until crisp.

name: Potato and cheese tortilla roll
description: Soft flour tortilla rolled with seasoned potato mash, herbs and melted cheese.
steps: Mash boiled potato with roasted cumin and chopped coriander.
Spread green chutney on tortilla, layer potato and cheese.
Roll into a tight log and pan fry in oil until outer wrap is crisp.

name: Sweet corn and paneer sandwich
description: Juicy sweet corn and grated paneer seasoned with green chillies, toasted to golden perfection.
steps: Mix steamed corn, grated paneer, black pepper and salt.
Place mixture between bread slices.
Toast in a pan with butter until crunchy on both sides.

name: Falafel and tahini yogurt wrap
description: Air fried golden chickpea falafels with garlic yogurt sauce and crunchy cucumber in a pita wrap.
steps: Blend cooked chickpeas with garlic, cumin, coriander and salt into a coarse paste, then form small balls.
Air fry or pan fry until deeply golden and crisp.
Wrap in warm pita with cucumber slices and garlic yogurt sauce.

name: Grilled cheese and tomato sandwich
description: Classic comfort food with thick sliced cheese and ripe tomatoes griddled until golden brown.
steps: Butter the outer sides of bread slices.
Layer generous cheese, ripe tomato slices and oregano inside.
Griddle over gentle heat until the bread is crisp and cheese is fully melted.

name: Vegetable fried rice
description: Wok tossed fragrant rice with finely diced carrots, beans, spring onions and dark soy sauce.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat, sauté mixed vegetables for two minutes until tender crisp.
Add cold cooked rice and drizzle soy sauce and pepper.
Toss vigorously for three minutes and finish with spring onions.

name: Paneer fried rice
description: High heat fried rice with golden pan seared paneer cubes, crunchy vegetables and garlic.
steps: Sear paneer cubes in oil until golden, then set aside.
Stir fry vegetables in the same wok on high heat.
Add cooked rice, paneer cubes and soy sauce, tossing for three minutes.

name: Garlic butter vegetable noodles
description: Silky noodles tossed in browned garlic butter with crunchy cabbage, capsicum and carrots.
steps: Boil noodles according to package directions, drain and rinse.
Melt butter in a pan, sizzle minced garlic until fragrant and light golden.
Toss vegetables and cooked noodles into the garlic butter, seasoning with black pepper.

name: Chilli garlic paneer noodles
description: Spicy stir fried noodles tossed with garlic chilli sauce, seared paneer and bell peppers.
steps: Boil and drain noodles.
Sear paneer cubes and bell pepper in oil over high heat.
Toss in boiled noodles and chilli garlic sauce until thoroughly coated and fragrant.

name: Creamy mushroom pasta
description: Penne pasta enveloped in a velvety garlic milk sauce with pan browned button mushrooms.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté sliced mushrooms and garlic in butter until deep brown.
Pour in milk, stir in cheese and cooked pasta, simmering until sauce is creamy and coats the pasta.

name: Tangy tomato and cheese pasta
description: Pasta tossed in a zesty basil tomato sauce and finished with melted cheese.
steps: Cook pasta until tender.
Simmer tomato puree with minced garlic, olive oil, salt and herbs for eight minutes.
Toss pasta into sauce, stir in grated cheese until melted and serve hot.

name: White sauce vegetable pasta
description: Classic béchamel style pasta loaded with sweet corn, capsicum and melted cheese.
steps: Boil pasta until tender.
Melt butter, stir in atta to make a roux, then whisk in milk until smooth and thick.
Add boiled pasta, steamed corn and cheese, stirring until rich and velvety.

name: Macaroni with cheese and vegetables
description: Homestyle stovetop mac and cheese packed with peas, carrots and a creamy cheese sauce.
steps: Boil macaroni and mixed vegetables together until tender, then drain.
Stir in milk, butter and grated cheese over low heat.
Simmer gently until cheese melts into a thick velvety sauce.

name: Paneer pesto pasta
description: Al dente pasta tossed with fresh herb pesto and golden pan seared paneer cubes.
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Sear paneer cubes in oil until golden.
Toss hot pasta with pesto sauce, paneer cubes and a sprinkle of cheese.

name: Vegetable burrito rice bowl
description: Mexican style rice bowl with spiced kidney beans, sweet corn, salsa and shredded cheese.
steps: Warm cooked rice and place at the base of a bowl.
Heat rajma with salsa and sweet corn, then spoon over the rice.
Garnish with grated cheese and fresh coriander.

name: Sweet corn and cheese rice bowl
description: Comforting buttery rice bowl loaded with sweet corn, black pepper and melted cheddar style cheese.
steps: Warm cooked rice with butter, sweet corn and black pepper in a pan for three minutes.
Transfer to a bowl and fold in grated cheese while hot so it melts through.
Serve warm with extra cracked pepper.

name: Paneer teriyaki style rice bowl
description: Glazed sweet and savoury paneer cubes served over steamed rice with sesame seeds and peppers.
steps: Pan sear paneer and bell pepper until golden.
Pour in soy sauce mixed with honey and simmer for one minute until sticky and glazed.
Serve over warm rice and scatter sesame seeds on top.

name: Schezwan vegetable fried rice
description: Spicy wok tossed rice with schezwan sauce, crunchy beans, carrots and cabbage.
steps: Stir fry mixed vegetables in hot oil on high flame for two minutes.
Add cold cooked rice and schezwan sauce.
Toss rapidly until evenly coloured and piping hot.

name: Mild peanut sauce noodles
description: Noodles tossed in a creamy peanut dressing with cucumber ribbons and crushed peanuts.
steps: Boil noodles, drain and cool slightly.
Whisk peanut butter with warm water, soy sauce and lemon juice until smooth.
Toss noodles with the peanut sauce, sliced cucumber and crushed peanuts.

name: Paneer rice bowl with vegetables
description: Steamed rice bowl topped with golden pan seared paneer cubes and sautéed seasonal vegetables.
steps: Sear paneer cubes in ghee until golden, remove and set aside.
Sauté mixed vegetables with cumin seeds and salt in the same pan.
Layer rice in a bowl, top with sautéed vegetables and golden paneer.

name: Chole and potato bowl
description: Warm spiced chickpeas tossed with roasted potato cubes, lemon juice and fresh coriander.
steps: Dice boiled potato and pan fry in oil until crispy.
Toss warm chickpeas, crispy potatoes, chopped onion, chaat masala and lemon juice together.
Serve in a deep bowl garnished with fresh coriander.

name: Dal chawal with aloo jeera
description: Comforting yellow dal over rice served with homestyle cumin roasted potatoes.
steps: Cook dal and rice until tender.
Sauté diced potatoes with cumin seeds, turmeric and salt until golden and tender.
Serve as a complete comfort platter.

name: Homemade paneer burrito
description: Large flour tortilla stuffed with spiced paneer cubes, kidney beans, salsa and cheese.
steps: Sauté paneer cubes and rajma with salsa for three minutes.
Place in tortilla, top with cheese and fold tightly into a burrito.
Toast seam side down on a dry skillet until sealed and warm.

name: Vegetable and paneer fried noodles
description: Wok tossed hakka style noodles with paneer strips, cabbage, carrots and spring onions.
steps: Boil noodles and drain.
Sauté paneer strips and shredded vegetables on high heat for three minutes.
Toss with noodles, soy sauce and black pepper.

name: Grilled paneer sandwich with potato wedges
description: Toasted paneer and cheese sandwich served alongside crispy spiced air fried potato wedges.
steps: Cut potato into wedges, toss with oil and chaat masala, and air fry at 200 C for twelve minutes.
Assemble sandwich with paneer and cheese, toasting in a pan until golden.
Serve hot together.

name: Rajma wrap with yogurt sauce
description: Warm seasoned kidney beans wrapped in a whole wheat roti with cool mint yogurt sauce.
steps: Whisk curd with mint chutney.
Warm cooked rajma with a pinch of roasted cumin.
Assemble in a warm roti with sliced onions and rolled tightly.

name: Creamy corn and paneer pasta
description: Penne pasta enveloped in a velvety milk cheese sauce with sweet corn and paneer cubes.
steps: Cook pasta until tender.
Sear paneer cubes lightly in a pan.
Simmer milk, corn, cheese and pasta together until creamy, then fold in paneer cubes.

name: Mild vegetable Manchurian with rice
description: Steamed vegetable dumplings tossed in a mild ginger garlic soy sauce, served with rice.
steps: Form grated cabbage and carrot into balls with cornflour, then shallow fry or steam.
Simmer soy sauce, garlic, ginger and water with a cornflour slurry to make a glossy sauce.
Toss the dumplings in the sauce and serve over hot steamed rice.

name: Paneer and sweet corn pulao
description: Fragrant basmati rice gently spiced with whole cumin, juicy sweet corn and golden paneer.
steps: Sear paneer cubes in ghee until golden, then set aside.
Sauté sweet corn, cumin seeds and rinsed rice in the same pot.
Add measured water and simmer covered until fluffy, then fold in paneer.

name: Stuffed paneer paratha with curd
description: Two generous parathas stuffed with fresh seasoned paneer, served with chilled curd.
steps: Grate paneer and season with garam masala, salt and coriander.
Roll into atta dough balls, seal carefully and roll flat.
Roast on a hot skillet with oil until puffed and crisp. Serve with fresh curd.

name: Air fried tandoori chicken with roti
description: Yogurt marinated chicken breast with aromatic spices, air fried and served with warm roti.
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger garlic paste and tandoori masala for ten minutes.
Air fry at 190 C for sixteen to twenty minutes, turning halfway through.
Warm rotis and serve with chicken and sliced peppers.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Homemade steamed chicken momos
description: Delicate steamed dumplings stuffed with juicy seasoned chicken and served with spicy tomato dip.
steps: Mix chicken mince with finely chopped cabbage, spring onion, minced ginger, garlic and salt.
Place a spoonful of filling on each wrapper and pleat closed firmly.
Steam in a momo steamer for twelve to fifteen minutes until fully cooked.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Steamed vegetable momos with soup
description: Soft steamed dumplings filled with finely shredded seasoned vegetables, served with hot clear broth.
steps: Finely grate vegetables and toss with soy sauce, pepper and salt.
Fill wrappers, pleat closed and arrange in a steamer.
Steam for twelve minutes and serve with spicy dip and hot vegetable soup.

name: Steamed paneer momos with spicy garlic dip
description: Steamed parcels packed with fresh spiced paneer, onions and herbs, paired with garlic chutney.
steps: Grate paneer and combine with finely chopped onion, black pepper and salt.
Pleat into wrappers tightly.
Steam for twelve minutes until wrappers turn glossy and translucent.

name: Pan fried vegetable dumplings
description: Vegetable dumplings seared in a skillet for a crispy bottom, then steamed to tender perfection.
steps: Fill and fold wrappers around seasoned vegetables.
Sear bottoms in a hot oiled skillet for two minutes until crisp and brown.
Add two tablespoons of water, cover immediately and steam for eight minutes.

name: Chilli garlic paneer with fried rice
description: Crisp paneer cubes tossed in a spicy garlic sauce, served over vegetable fried rice.
steps: Pan fry paneer cubes until golden and crisp at edges.
Sauté bell peppers with chilli garlic sauce and a splash of water.
Toss paneer into the sauce and serve alongside warm fried rice.

name: Crispy air fried paneer bites
description: Crunchy cornflour crusted paneer cubes cooked in the air fryer, served with sweet chilli dip.
steps: Cut paneer into bite sized cubes and toss with cornflour, salt and a light spray of oil.
Air fry at 200 C for twelve to fourteen minutes until golden and crunchy.
Dust with chaat masala and serve with sweet chilli dip.

name: Vegetable Manchurian with steamed rice
description: Crispy vegetable balls simmered in an aromatic dark soy and garlic gravy, with steamed rice.
steps: Mix finely minced cabbage and carrot with cornflour, shape into balls and shallow fry.
Prepare gravy with minced garlic, soy sauce, spring onions and a light cornflour slurry.
Add vegetable balls to gravy and serve hot over rice.

name: Chilli potato with vegetable fried rice
description: Crisp air fried potato fingers glazed in sweet chilli garlic sauce, paired with fried rice.
steps: Cut potatoes into fingers, toss with cornflour and air fry until very crisp.
Glaze quickly in a wok with sweet chilli sauce and spring onions.
Serve immediately alongside vegetable fried rice.

name: Garlic noodles with paneer
description: Silky wheat noodles stir fried with roasted garlic, soy sauce and golden paneer cubes.
steps: Boil noodles and rinse in cold water.
Sear paneer cubes in oil with minced garlic until golden.
Add noodles and soy sauce, tossing over high heat for three minutes.

name: Homemade vegetable spring rolls
description: Crispy thin wrappers filled with sautéed spiced cabbage and carrots, air fried until golden.
steps: Stir fry shredded cabbage and carrots with soy sauce and black pepper until dry.
Place filling in spring roll pastry sheets and roll tightly, sealing edges with water.
Brush with oil and air fry at 190 C for twelve minutes until crisp.

name: Crispy corn with vegetable fried rice
description: Crunchy battered sweet corn tossed with pepper, served over comforting vegetable fried rice.
steps: Coat sweet corn in cornflour and air fry or pan crisp until crunchy.
Toss with salt, black pepper and spring onions.
Serve over piping hot vegetable fried rice.

name: Sesame garlic paneer rice bowl
description: Seared paneer in a glossy sesame garlic sauce served over steamed rice with broccoli.
steps: Pan fry paneer cubes until golden on all sides.
Simmer minced garlic, soy sauce, a touch of honey and water until glossy.
Toss paneer in sauce, spoon over rice and sprinkle toasted sesame seeds.

name: Homemade crispy paneer burger
description: Thick paneer patty pan seared until crusty, served in a toasted bun with mint sauce and onion.
steps: Season a thick slab of paneer with chaat masala and roast in an oiled pan until golden on both sides.
Toast the burger bun lightly.
Assemble with mint chutney, crisp onion rings and the hot paneer patty.

name: Golden aloo tikki burger with mint dip
description: Spiced potato patty fried crisp, layered with cool mint sauce and tomato in a warm bun.
steps: Mash boiled potato with chaat masala and shape into a sturdy patty.
Pan fry in oil until deeply browned and crunchy.
Toast bun and assemble with tomato and mint dip.

name: Crispy cheese potato burger
description: Crunchy potato patty topped with melted cheese in a toasted bun with fresh tomato.
steps: Shape seasoned mashed potato into a patty and pan fry until golden.
Place cheese slice on top in the final minute so it softens.
Slide into toasted burger bun with sliced tomato.

name: Homemade margherita pizza
description: Crispy thin crust base spread with rich tomato basil sauce and bubbling melted mozzarella style cheese.
steps: Spread tomato sauce evenly across the pizza base.
Scatter grated cheese generously and sprinkle with oregano.
Bake or cook in a covered skillet until crust is crunchy and cheese is melted and bubbling.

name: Thin crust paneer tikka pizza
description: Spiced paneer cubes, diced bell peppers and melted cheese on a crisp pizza crust.
steps: Toss paneer and pepper with tikka spices.
Spread sauce on base, arrange paneer and vegetables, then cover with cheese.
Bake until cheese is golden and bubbling.

name: Garlic bread with creamy pasta
description: Silky white sauce pasta served alongside homemade toasted garlic herb bread.
steps: Cook pasta and toss in a creamy sauce made from milk, butter and cheese.
Spread butter mixed with minced garlic on bread and toast until crunchy.
Serve together warm.

name: Baked mac and cheese with vegetables
description: Tender macaroni and sweet peas baked in a velvety cheese sauce until golden on top.
steps: Boil macaroni and peas until tender.
Whisk butter, a spoonful of flour, milk and grated cheese into a thick sauce.
Fold macaroni into cheese sauce and broil briefly until bubbly.

name: Crispy potato wedges with warm cheese dip
description: Air fried spiced potato wedges served with a rich dipping sauce made from melted cheese and milk.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and chaat masala, and air fry at 200 C for eighteen minutes.
Melt cheese gently with milk in a small saucepan over low heat until smooth.
Serve the hot crispy wedges with warm cheese dip.

name: Toasted paneer and onion quesadilla
description: Crisp golden tortilla filled with seasoned grated paneer, red onion and melted cheese.
steps: Mix grated paneer with chopped onion, green chilli and salt.
Spread over half the tortilla, cover with cheese, and fold in half.
Toast in a buttered pan over medium heat until crispy on both sides.

name: Loaded baked potato with cheese
description: Tender baked potato fluffed inside with butter, topped with melted cheese and seasoned curd.
steps: Poke holes in potato and microwave or air fry until completely soft inside.
Slice open, fluff interior with butter and black pepper.
Top with grated cheese to melt, and finish with a spoonful of cool curd.

name: Cheese and corn tortilla pizza
description: Ultra thin crispy tortilla base topped with pizza sauce, sweet corn kernels and bubbling cheese.
steps: Spread pizza sauce over tortilla.
Scatter sweet corn, grated cheese and oregano.
Cook in a covered skillet over medium heat for seven minutes until bottom is cracker crisp.

name: Grilled cheese with roasted tomato soup
description: Crispy buttered grilled cheese sandwich paired with a warm bowl of smooth tomato soup.
steps: Simmer tomato puree with minced garlic, water, salt and herbs for ten minutes.
Toast bread with cheese and butter until crunchy and melted.
Dip hot crunchy sandwich into warm tomato soup.

name: Air fried paneer tikka with jeera rice
description: Smoky air fried paneer cubes and peppers served over warm fragrant jeera rice.
steps: Marinate paneer and bell peppers in curd and tikka spices for ten minutes.
Air fry at 190 C for twelve minutes until edges are charred.
Serve hot over fluffy jeera rice.

name: Paneer bhurji rolls with mint yogurt
description: Spiced scrambled paneer rolled into warm rotis with a drizzle of refreshing mint yogurt.
steps: Sauté onions and tomatoes, add crumbled paneer and cook for four minutes.
Whisk curd with mint chutney.
Spoon paneer bhurji into warm rotis, drizzle with mint yogurt and roll tightly.

name: Creamy paneer with soft roti
description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a mildly seasoned milk and tomato gravy, served with rotis.
steps: Cook tomato puree in butter with mild spices.
Pour in milk, stir continuously, then add paneer cubes and simmer for five minutes.
Serve alongside soft warm rotis.

name: Fragrant paneer pulao with raita
description: Aromatic basmati rice cooked with paneer, peas and whole spices, cooled by cucumber raita.
steps: Sauté whole spices and paneer cubes in ghee.
Add peas, rice, water and salt, then cook until rice is tender and fragrant.
Serve with chilled cucumber raita.

name: Spiced rajma burrito bowl
description: Comforting Mexican style bowl with seasoned kidney beans, warm rice, salsa and cheese.
steps: Warm cooked rajma with salsa in a pan for three minutes.
Place warm rice into a bowl, spoon the beans over.
Top with shredded cheese, cucumber salad and coriander.

name: Chole wraps with garlic yogurt sauce
description: Tender spiced chickpeas rolled into a warm flatbread with creamy garlic yogurt sauce.
steps: Warm chickpeas with cumin and chaat masala.
Whisk curd with minced garlic and a pinch of salt.
Roll into warm roti with sliced onions and serve.

name: Rich dal makhani with jeera rice
description: Velvety black lentils simmered with butter and gentle spices, served over hot jeera rice.
steps: Simmer cooked black lentils and tomato puree with butter and mild spices for twenty minutes.
Temper rice with cumin seeds in a separate pan.
Serve the creamy dal over hot rice.

name: Vegetable and paneer skewers with flatbread
description: Air fried spiced paneer and pepper skewers served alongside warm flatbread and mint dip.
steps: Thread paneer, bell pepper and onion chunks onto skewers.
Brush with oil and tikka spices, then air fry at 190 C for twelve minutes.
Slide off skewers into warm flatbread with mint dip.

name: Stuffed potato and paneer patties
description: Golden patties made of spiced mashed potato stuffed with seasoned paneer, pan fried until crisp.
steps: Mash boiled potato with salt and cumin to make outer dough.
Stuff with crumbled paneer and chaat masala, then shape into thick discs.
Pan fry in oil until deeply crisp on both sides. Serve with curd.

name: Cheese stuffed garlic naan with paneer
description: Stovetop flatbread stuffed with molten cheese and minced garlic, served with paneer bhurji.
steps: Roll dough, stuff with grated cheese and minced garlic, seal and roll gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with butter until puffed and golden brown.
Serve hot alongside quickly sautéed paneer.

name: Mild paneer korma with rice
description: Silky aromatic paneer curry cooked with yogurt, ground spices and melon seeds, with steamed rice.
steps: Whisk curd with coriander powder, turmeric and salt.
Simmer the curd sauce gently in ghee without boiling vigorously, then add paneer cubes.
Cook covered for ten minutes and serve with steamed rice.

name: Air fried garlic chilli chicken
description: Juicy chicken pieces tossed in garlic, mild heat and olive oil, air fried until succulent.
steps: Toss chicken pieces with curd, minced garlic, a pinch of red chilli and salt.
Air fry at 190 C for fifteen to eighteen minutes until golden.
Serve with warm rice and crisp vegetables.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Honey garlic chicken rice bowl
description: Air fried chicken bites coated in a sticky honey garlic glaze, served over steamed rice.
steps: Cut chicken into bite sized pieces, season lightly and air fry at 190 C for twelve minutes.
Simmer honey, minced garlic and soy sauce in a pan for two minutes until syrupy.
Toss chicken in glaze and serve over warm rice.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Air fried chicken tikka wraps
description: Spiced yogurt marinated chicken bites air fried and wrapped in soft flatbread with mint sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in curd and tikka masala for ten minutes.
Air fry at 190 C for fourteen to sixteen minutes until lightly charred at edges.
Wrap in a warm roti with sliced onions and mint sauce.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Chicken and cheese quesadilla
description: Toasted flour tortilla packed with seasoned diced chicken and bubbling melted cheese.
steps: Dice chicken small and pan sear with fajita seasoning until cooked through.
Arrange chicken, peppers and cheese across half the tortilla, folding closed.
Toast in a buttered pan until golden and crisp.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Mild chilli chicken with rice
description: Tender chicken chunks stir fried with bell peppers, onions and mild soy garlic sauce, over rice.
steps: Stir fry sliced chicken in a hot oiled pan until browned.
Add sliced bell peppers, onions and soy sauce, cooking for four minutes.
Serve alongside steamed white rice.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Garlic butter chicken with roast potatoes
description: Air fried seasoned chicken tenders and potato wedges tossed in hot garlic herb butter.
steps: Cut chicken and potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, salt and pepper.
Air fry together at 190 C for eighteen minutes, shaking halfway.
Toss immediately in melted garlic herb butter and serve hot.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Chicken and vegetable fried rice
description: Wok tossed fried rice with tender seasoned chicken bites, diced carrots, beans and soy sauce.
steps: Sear finely diced chicken in hot oil until cooked through.
Add mixed vegetables and stir fry for two minutes.
Toss with cold cooked rice and soy sauce on high heat.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Sweet chilli chicken wraps
description: Crisp air fried chicken strips tossed in sweet chilli sauce, rolled into warm tortillas with greens.
steps: Cut chicken into strips and air fry at 190 C for fourteen minutes until crisp.
Toss in sweet chilli sauce.
Wrap in a warm tortilla with crunchy cucumber ribbons.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Crispy air fried chicken bites with potato wedges
description: Golden cornflour dusted chicken nuggets and seasoned potato wedges made in the air fryer.
steps: Toss diced chicken and potato batons with cornflour, spices and oil.
Air fry at 200 C for sixteen minutes until deeply crispy.
Dust with chaat masala and serve with dipping sauce.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Chicken and cheese toasted sandwich
description: Toasted crusty bread filled with shredded cooked chicken, cracked pepper and melted cheese.
steps: Layer shredded cooked chicken and cheese between bread slices.
Toast in a buttered pan over medium heat until crust is crisp and cheese is melted.
Serve hot with tomato dip.
Ensure the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 74 C before serving.

name: Creamy paneer and sweet corn pasta
description: Fusilli pasta tossed in creamy milk cheese sauce with sweet corn and paneer cubes.
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Sear paneer cubes and corn in a little butter.
Add milk, cheese and pasta, stirring until sauce is thick and glossy.

name: Homemade paneer and cheese calzone
description: Folded pizza pocket stuffed with spiced paneer, tomato sauce and molten mozzarella style cheese.
steps: Spread sauce on half of the rolled base, then layer paneer and cheese.
Fold over and crimp edges tightly to seal.
Bake or cook covered in a skillet until golden and crisp.

name: Vegetable and cheese baked potatoes
description: Soft baked potato halves loaded with sautéed corn, capsicum and melted cheese.
steps: Microwave or roast potato until tender, then halve and scoop out center.
Mash flesh with butter, corn, peppers and half the cheese, then spoon back into skins.
Top with remaining cheese and melt under a broiler or in a skillet.

name: Smoky paneer tikka rice bowl
description: Smoky grilled paneer tikka cubes served over hot basmati rice with cucumber salad.
steps: Toss paneer and peppers with curd and tikka masala.
Pan sear on high heat until nicely charred.
Serve over warm rice with fresh cucumber slices.

name: Chole and cheese quesadilla
description: Spiced chickpeas mashed lightly and folded with melted cheese in a crusty flour tortilla.
steps: Coarsely mash warm chickpeas with chaat masala.
Spread on tortilla, cover with grated cheese, and fold in half.
Griddle in a buttered pan until crunchy and melted.

name: Paneer garlic bread pizza
description: Thick garlic bread toasts topped with crumbled paneer, pizza sauce and bubbling melted cheese.
steps: Brush bread with garlic butter.
Top with a spoonful of sauce, crumbled paneer and cheese.
Melt in a covered pan until cheese bubbles and bread is crunchy.

name: Crispy spiced vegetable wraps
description: Pan crisped shredded cabbage, carrots and potatoes spiced with chaat masala in a warm roti.
steps: Stir fry thin potato batons and cabbage with turmeric and cumin until crisp.
Spread green chutney over warm roti.
Fill with crispy vegetables and roll.

name: Mild creamy vegetable noodles
description: Wheat noodles tossed in a light creamy milk and garlic sauce with carrots and peas.
steps: Boil noodles and drain.
Sauté vegetables in butter, add milk and black pepper, simmering gently.
Toss noodles into the creamy broth and serve warm.

name: Grilled paneer with seasoned potato wedges
description: Air fried spiced potato wedges served alongside thick pan grilled seasoned paneer slabs.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges and air fry with oil and salt at 200 C for sixteen minutes.
Pan grill paneer seasoned with tikka masala for three minutes per side.
Plate together with fresh mint chutney.

name: Homemade vegetable and cheese burrito
description: Large flour tortilla filled with spiced rice, kidney beans, crunchy peppers and melted cheese.
steps: Warm rice and rajma with salsa.
Place in tortilla, cover with cheese, and roll tightly.
Crisp in a dry skillet for two minutes until warm throughout.

name: Crispy roasted chana with chaat masala
description: Crunchy roasted black chickpeas dusted with tangy chaat masala and black salt.
steps: Toss roasted chana with chaat masala and a drop of lemon juice.
Enjoy as a quick crunchy snack.

name: Roasted makhana with black pepper and salt
description: Foxnuts roasted in ghee until ultra crunchy, seasoned with cracked black pepper.
steps: Roast makhana in ghee over low heat for five minutes until crisp when pressed.
Season with black pepper and salt immediately.

name: Warm sweet corn chaat with lemon
description: Steamed juicy sweet corn tossed with butter, chaat masala and fresh lemon juice.
steps: Steam sweet corn until tender.
Toss with butter, chaat masala and fresh lemon juice while warm.

name: Air fried aloo tikki with curd
description: Golden air fried spiced potato patty topped with chilled curd and roasted cumin.
steps: Shape boiled potato into a patty and air fry at 200 C for twelve minutes.
Top with whisked curd, chaat masala and roasted cumin.

name: Quick cheese toast
description: Warm toasted slice of bread with bubbling melted cheese and cracked pepper.
steps: Place cheese on bread and toast in a covered pan until melted and crisp.

name: Pan seared seasoned paneer cubes
description: Tender paneer cubes seared in ghee and dusted with roasted cumin and chaat spices.
steps: Pan sear paneer cubes in ghee for three minutes until lightly golden.
Dust with chaat masala and serve warm.

name: Yogurt cucumber dip with crackers
description: Thick chilled garlic cucumber yogurt dip served with crisp crackers.
steps: Whisk thick curd with grated cucumber, salt and mint.
Serve with crunchy crackers for dipping.

name: Stovetop salted popcorn
description: Light fluffy stovetop popped corn tossed with melted butter and fine salt.
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot, add kernels and cover.
Shake pot over medium heat until popping slows down.
Toss with melted butter and salt.

name: Crispy air fried potato wedges
description: Crisp spiced potato wedges made in the air fryer with chaat masala.
steps: Cut potato into wedges, toss with oil and salt.
Air fry at 200 C for fifteen minutes until crunchy.
Toss with chaat masala.

name: Mini vegetable quesadilla
description: Small tortilla folded with sweet corn, capsicum and melted cheese.
steps: Fill tortilla with corn and cheese, fold and toast in a buttered pan until crisp.

name: Spiced hummus with warm pita
description: Creamy blended chickpeas with garlic and olive oil, served with toasted pita triangles.
steps: Blend chickpeas with garlic, olive oil, lemon juice and salt until smooth.
Warm pita bread and serve together.

name: Cheese slices with fresh apple and grapes
description: Mellow cheese slices paired with crisp sweet apple wedges and fresh grapes.
steps: Slice apple neatly and arrange on a plate with cheese slices and grapes.

name: Mini paneer roll
description: Quick bite sized roti roll stuffed with seasoned crumbled paneer and mint chutney.
steps: Sauté crumbled paneer briefly with salt and cumin.
Spread mint chutney on warm roti, add paneer and roll up.

name: Sliced banana with peanut butter
description: Fresh sliced ripe banana served with rich natural peanut butter for dipping.
steps: Slice banana into coins and serve with creamy peanut butter.

name: Creamy yogurt with honey and seasonal fruit
description: Chilled creamy curd drizzled with wild honey and topped with fresh fruit slices.
steps: Spoon chilled curd into a bowl, top with fruit and drizzle honey.

name: Warm milk with soft dates
description: Mug of warm comforting milk served with naturally sweet Medjool dates.
steps: Warm milk in a small saucepan.
Serve in a mug accompanied by soft seeded dates.

name: Mini chocolate banana smoothie
description: Chilled small shake with banana, cocoa and cold milk.
steps: Blend banana, milk and cocoa until frothy and cold.

name: Crisp peanut butter toast
description: Single slice of hot golden toast spread with creamy peanut butter.
steps: Toast bread until golden and spread with peanut butter while warm.

name: Crisp apple slices with peanut butter
description: Crunchy sweet apple slices served with a dollop of peanut butter.
steps: Slice apple into wedges and serve with peanut butter.

name: Homemade one ingredient banana ice cream
description: Naturally sweet soft serve made purely from blended frozen banana coins.
steps: Blend frozen banana slices in a food processor or blender until thick and creamy.

name: Fresh strawberry and banana milkshake
description: Cold frothy milkshake blended with fresh strawberries and sweet banana.
steps: Blend strawberries, banana and milk until smooth and serve chilled.

name: Mini overnight oats cup
description: Small glass cup of chilled oats soaked in milk and finished with honey.
steps: Soak oats in milk with honey in the fridge for three hours.

name: Homemade yogurt parfait with granola
description: Layered cup of thick curd, crunchy granola and sweet diced apple.
steps: Layer curd, apple and granola in a small glass.

name: Soft dates stuffed with almonds and walnuts
description: Sweet soft dates filled with crunchy raw almonds and walnuts.
steps: Slit dates, remove pits, and insert almonds and walnuts.

name: Warm spiced milk with fresh banana
description: Comforting warm milk infused with cardamom, paired with a ripe sweet banana.
steps: Warm milk with cardamom and serve alongside a fresh banana.

name: Paneer tikka with roti
description: Charred edges, soft paneer and peppers with warm roti. A lovely dish when craving smoky flavour.
steps: Coat paneer and sliced bell peppers in curd and tikka spices.
Grill or pan sear on high heat until lightly charred at edges.
Serve warm with soft rotis.
